description: AI Compute Capacity Index: ranks data center markets by where 100MW of AI training capacity can land in the next 30/60/90 days. Returns top markets with facility_count, operator_count, deployable_mw estimate (megawatts), hyperscale_ready flag, rack power density and cooling-type signals where facility data carries them, and composite score (depth + diversity + power). Refreshed Fridays 14:00 UTC. Use for AI capex planning, GPU cluster siting, hyperscaler deal forecasting. For grid power availability use DCPI (rank_markets ai_ready). Do NOT use for a general best-markets ranking (use rank_markets) or forward grid-emergence (use grid_transition_radar).
